topics.title: Decorators
topics.notes: A decorator is a function that modifies or extends the behavior of another function. Decorators are commonly used for logging, authentication, timing and validation.

topics.title: Generators
topics.notes: A generator is a function that produces values one at a time using the yield keyword. Generators are memory efficient because they do not store all values in memory.

topics.title: Lambda
topics.notes: A lambda function is a small anonymous function. It can take any number of arguments but can have only one expression.
